liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Dicks wrote that this Dark Star into Morning Dew may be the best, with an unusual, thrilling jam; Nearly three minutes of Mind Left Body teases, then around 33:30 Jerry plays it fully, flowing into Morning Dew [7][9][15]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer lists Black Peter among the highlights, alongside Bird Song, Big Railroad Blues and Cumberland Blues [8]
- **Mississippi Half Step** (1 review): Reviewer hears an energetic, early version of Mississippi Half Step following Morning Dew [15]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Dicks singled out the Not Fade Away, Goin' Down the Road, Not Fade Away sequence as a delicious highlight [7]

## The recordings

- **gd72-09-21.sbd.masse.7296.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 226 min; rated 4.42/5 by 65 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer reports superb sound quality and high volume, with a couple of small glitches [15]
- **gd1972-09-21.150281.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 27 songs; 229 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1972-09-21.138083.sbd.mitchell-flaschner.flac1644**: soundboard; 27 songs; 225 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1972-09-21.152463.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: audience recording; 27 songs; 221 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Dicks called this one of his favorite shows ever, in an essay reviewing 1972 [7]
- Reviewer says this show stands alongside the 5/11 and 8/27 shows, and agrees the Dark Star-Dew pairing is best [8]
- Reviewer thinks this may be Bobby's finest night, with very strong singing and playing throughout [12]
- This soundboard source runs longer than the other circulating sources [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-09-21.sbd.masse.7296.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard to reel, DAT, CDR, EAC, then shn, via Mike Masse; flaws are listed in the info file [1]
- **gd1972-09-21.150281.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 25, 2020; source: SBD > Master Reel (7-inch 7.5ips 1/2trk) > DAT (44.1k) [3]. Also: The start of Friend of the Devil is cut because of a reel change [3]
- **gd1972-09-21.138083.sbd.mitchell-flaschner.flac1644**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Jeff Mitchell; source: flac16 SBD > Reel > DAT; DAT(c) @ 44.1kHz > Tascam DA-20 > Tascam DR-680 MKII > Canare Coax > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite (Build 35) > TLH v2.7.0 (flac 8, ffp) >… [2]
- **gd1972-09-21.152463.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: taped by from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: uknown audience cassette from the collection of Doug Lamarre [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Spectrum - September 21, 1972](https://www.dead.net/show/september-21-1972) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Spectrum](https://www.dead.net/venue/spectrum) [24]
